versions.changelog:
Initial release of method-logic-diagnostic: a skill for evaluating the logic and reasoning quality in psychology paper Methods sections.

- Diagnoses logic and justification problems in Methods sections, assessing method selection, design coherence, variable/control rigor, and appropriateness of limitation disclosures.
- Provides structured scoring and top-journal positive examples for reference.
- Follows the full rule set from "Science Research Writing" (2nd ed.) Unit 2, including option comparisons, six-component model, justification requirements, and disclosure conventions.
- Anchors all checks on four integrated resources: authoritative textbook sections, a 124-item diagnostic checklist, a detailed grading rubric, and curated top-journal exemplars.
- User-invocable for targeted, dimension-specific academic writing feedback.
